name: Update task scheduler
whenToUse: Modify an existing task scheduler by hashed id, changing pause state, interval, job, or dates (mutating).

headerParameters.name: X-API-SECRET
headerParameters.description: The API secret as defined by the .env variable API_SECRET. Only needed for self hosted users, and only applicable on the login route.

fields.name: start_from
fields.description: Timestamp when we should start the scheduler, default is today

fields.name: job
fields.description: Job, we can find list of available jobs in Scheduler model

fields.name: date_range
fields.description: The string representation of the date range of data to be returned

fields.name: date_key
fields.description: The date column to search between.

fields.name: start_date
fields.description: The start date to search between

fields.name: end_date
fields.description: The end date to search between
